dialogues.en:
This is a perfect season to have a good sleep, but there's
something that's disrupting my sweet sleep.
dialogues.text:
This is a perfect season to have a good sleep, but there's
something that's disrupting my sweet sleep.

dialogues.en:
That's my supernatural power. It makes me see other people's
dreams.
dialogues.text:
That's my supernatural power. It makes me see other people's
dreams.

dialogues.en:
It's such a beautiful spring day, and there's a sweet
temptation for me to sleep so much that I even become a
mummy.
dialogues.text:
It's such a beautiful spring day, and there's a sweet
temptation for me to sleep so much that I even become a
mummy.

dialogues.jp:
寝るには持ってこいの季節だってのに、俺の安
眠を妨害する奴が居る。

例の能力だ。強制的に人の夢を見せられてしま
うという、あの。
dialogues.en:
If I resist, I might be able to go under the sea of sound
sleep again.
dialogues.text:
If I resist, I might be able to go under the sea of sound
sleep again.

dialogues.en:
But if I stay exhausted like a jellyfish, I may drift into
someone's dreams.
dialogues.text:
But if I stay exhausted like a jellyfish, I may drift into
someone's dreams.

dialogues.jp:
春うららかな陽気はあまりに甘美な誘いだった。
そのままミイラにだってなれそうな程に。
dialogues.en:
And those other people's dreams usually sweep my sleepiness
away like triple crown winners.
dialogues.text:
And those other people's dreams usually sweep my sleepiness
away like triple crown winners.

dialogues.jp:
抵抗すれば、たぶん、また眠りの海に潜ってい
くことが出来る。

反対に、このままクラゲのように脱力していれ
ば誰かの夢へと流れ着くだろう。
dialogues.en: I'll force myself to go to sleep.
dialogues.text: I'll force myself to go to sleep.

dialogues.jp:
眠りの海をたゆたっていた俺だが、『他人の夢』
へと誘われる予兆を感じた。
正直かったるいが、さてどうしたものか……。
